Stack Influence | Multiple Openings: Full Stack Developer, Technical Product Manager, Product Designer & UX Research | Full-time | Remote (Worldwide) We’re a VC-backed, fully-remote, fast-growing creator marketplace connecting eCommerce brands with everyday social media users.

• Senior Full Stack JavaScript Developer ($125-200k USD): Modern tech stack—React, Node.js, Next.js, and Azure. Individual contributor on a small team with no mentoring duties and a 4-day work week.

• Product Designer and UX Researcher($120-180k USD): Hybrid design and research role. 4-day work week

• Technical Product Manager ($150-225k USD): Business-minded ex-engineer with SQL, analytics, and integration skills. 4-day work week
